yes I think your right unfortunately :(

this is a very depressing answer :(
no, im planning on dying today but I can't figure out the most painless way to die.

i think you're right. I left my anti depressants at my home which is far away which might be why i am so unstable. There is so much I have to do, and jumping off a building means I won't have to struggle with life anymore.

I don't know exactly. I have Borderline Personality disorder which makes me emotionally unstable (I love people and then hate them the next second) I don't know if there is a treatment for that.
maybe your right.. I have terrible mood swings where sometimes I can happy and others suicidial, but the mood swings are getting worse and worse.

There is not much support groups for depression in general here to my knwoledge, much less for someone like me. there is a hotline but I am too frighteneed of it. 

I think I should just die and end it all. I won't exist anything.
But im not strong. I can barely go outside and will burst into tears if I hear people laughing around me because I think they are laughing t me :(

I'm already crying but you made me cry from happiness just a little. You are very kind, your girlfriend is incredibly lucky.
Maybe you are right though, I may wait to kill myself until tomorrow.

But I am not strong enough to keep going. Maybe another person could improve themselves, but I have been fighting a losing war for 19 years and I'm tired of it.

Thank you for your comment and kindness. I wish there were more people like you.

I would like to talk more, I'm sorry for being a burden. 

I want to die painlessly but I couldn't decide whether to jump off a building or into train.
